Quick note ahead of the lab — here's the mapping heuristic I'll apply during the session:

- Commit: Signed PO / legal approval received OR contract value >= threshold and AE attests to 95% probability
- Best Case: Verbal agreement + active procurement engagement + timeline within quarter
- Pipeline: All earlier-stage opportunities, discovery or evaluation in progress

Example mapping (will demo live):
- 'Vendor Eval - Final' -> Best Case
- 'Contracting - Legal' -> Commit (if countersigned) or Best Case (if awaiting signature)

If you can attach your internal stage list to the shared sheet (link below), I'll pre-populate suggested mappings so we can iterate faster in the lab.

—Naomi
